item.title: Kurutta Kyoutou No.2 ~Kono Shihai kara no Sotsugyou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ja no Michi wa Hebi Soft
  • 発売日: 2010-06-18
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狂った教頭 No.2～この支配からの卒業～
  • 英語名: Kurutta Kyoutou No.2 Kono Shihai kara no Sotsugyou

あらすじ

Igisugi Seiji, who used to passionately lecture students around the school, is involved in a minor incident and nearly loses his job. However, for some reason, he is picked up by the vice-principal of the prestigious “Gogaku Gakuen” and returns to teaching. But it is an abnormal school ruled by the vice-principal, Fudou Kageshi. The “school rules” are strictly enforced, and those who break them are subjected to sexual punishment without exception. If you wear underwear other than the designated ones, they will be forcibly stripped off and confiscated. Those who are late for class are made to stand naked as a warning to others. Igisugi is shocked that such things can be done, and the vice-principal says to him: “So, were the school rules followed at the academy you attended? No, were the rules even enforced? Rules without consequences are meaningless. This is all for the students’ sake!” While understanding the vice-principal’s point of view, he felt he should resign if he cared about the students. Isugi was tormented by the gap between reality and ideals. What should he do?

あらすじ

He doesn’t know why, but he is ordered to take part in honey trap practice as a practice partner. Also, he gets to know that Akira, his cousin, is kidnapped by their enemy. He is given a new order and starts working on it….

item.title: Kurutta Kyoutou ~Danzai no Gakuen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ja no Michi wa Hebi Soft
  • 発売日: 2005-08-12
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狂った教頭～断罪の学園～
  • 英語名: Kurutta Kyoutou Danzai no Gakuen

あらすじ

The vice principal of Kousei Gakuen is troubled by the students’ disregard for public morals.

No matter how hard he tries to enforce them, there is no end to the number of students who break school rules.

Moreover, the teachers continue to teach with no enthusiasm, and the violations of the rules by the granddaughter of the board chairman, who is a problem child, has been tacitly tolerated.

item.title: Sengoku no Imouto Shichinin no Imouto
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ja no Michi wa Hebi Soft
  • 発売日: 2005-03-25
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦国の妹 七人の妹
  • 英語名: Sengoku no Imouto Shichinin no Imouto

あらすじ

Setting is old Japan.

Your village asked you to go and hire bodyguards to protect it against the bandits, so you went with your younger-sister-like-childhood-friend Suzu-chan and hired six (technically five) people, all girls. When you came back, the villagers become suspicious of those people they didn’t know, even more since they were all females and they couldn’t imagine them being bodyguards at all.
